en.headline: 59-year-old man dies after rescue from Tai Mei Tuk triathlon swim
en.dek: A participant in the Hong Kong Summer Triathlon Challenge was recovered from the sea after several hours and later certified dead in hospital.
body: A 59-year-old man died on Sunday after being rescued from the water during a triathlon at Tai Mei Tuk Water Sports Centre in Tai Po.

Police received a report at about 7.57am that the man, competing in the swimming segment of the 2026 Hong Kong Summer Triathlon Challenge organised by the Triathlon Association of Hong Kong China, had entered the water earlier and not returned to shore. His bicycle and other personal items were found on land. Search operations involving firefighters, marine police and divers continued for several hours.

The man was recovered from the sea off Tai Mei Tuk in the afternoon, unconscious, and taken to hospital for treatment. He was later certified dead. Police had classified the case as a missing person investigation.
Earlier in the day, some participants described the water conditions at the start of the swim as relatively calm, with no distress calls reported during the event.

zh.headline: 大美督三項鐵人賽男子遇溺 救起後不治
zh.dek: 一名59歲男子在大埔大美督參加夏日三項鐵人挑戰賽游泳項目期間失蹤數小時，下午被救起送院後證實死亡。
body: 一名59歲男子周日在大埔大美督水上活動中心參加三項鐵人賽期間懷疑遇溺，下午被救起送院後不治。
警方於上午約7時57分接獲報案，指該名男子參加由中國香港三項鐵人總會舉辦的「2026香港夏日三項鐵人挑戰賽」游泳項目後未有上岸，其單車及個人物品留在岸上。消防、水警及蛙人隨即展開搜救行動，持續至下午。
消防人員於下午在大美督對開海面救起已陷入昏迷的男子，立即送院搶救，其後證實死亡。警方早前將案件列作失蹤人士跟進。
部分參賽者較早時表示，游泳項目開始時水面相對平靜，賽事期間未聞有人呼救。
